And the affix क्विप् is also seen after all verbs, whether having an उपपद or not in the Vedic as well as in the modern Sanskṛt.

Terms: क्विप्
A अङ्ग (stem) formed with the affix क्विन् under स्पृशोऽनुदके क्विन्

etc. substitutes, at the end of a word, a guttural for the final consonant.

Terms: Guttural
